title: Transport and Getting Around
introduction: Name familiar forms of transport and say how people travel.
definition: Name familiar forms of transport and say how people travel.
rules: Name familiar forms of transport and say how people travel.

examples.question: Which travels on water: boat or bus?
steps: Read the prompt and choose the word that fits.

examples.question: Which has two wheels and pedals: bicycle or train?
steps: Read the prompt and choose the word that fits.

exercises.question: Which travels on water: boat or bus?
exercises.solution: A boat travels on water; a bus travels on roads.

exercises.question: Which has two wheels and pedals: bicycle or train?
exercises.solution: A bicycle has two wheels and pedals.

exercises.question: Which travels on rails: train or car?
exercises.solution: A train travels along railway tracks.

exercises.question: Complete: I go to school ___ bus. (by or on)
exercises.solution: Use by with a means of transport when describing how you travel.

exercises.question: Which flies in the sky: aeroplane or bicycle?
exercises.solution: An aeroplane flies through the air; a bicycle travels on land.

summary: Name familiar forms of transport and say how people travel.
